data.long_meaning: A name derived from the Arabic word ‘ibtasama’, meaning to be satisfied or fulfilled. This name carries a spiritual significance, as it reflects the deep inner contentment and peace that comes from a strong connection to Allah and living in accordance with His commandments. The name Ebtesam carries the meaning “Fulfillment, satisfaction” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Ebtesam usually hope their child will grow to embody fulfillment, satisfaction and live with faith, good character and purpose.
